//: One number per fli check rule id — the count that may never rise. Absent = 0 = clean. `fli check --update` locks in an improvement and cannot raise; `fli check --adopt` records what is there, which is the verb for taking debt on. The findings still print either way.
//app-layout: Adopted when CI first graded the rule here (FJS-D1009). web/src/displays.js is a module loose in web/src that belongs in web/src/lib/<area>/. The other five cross a surface by relative path (Invariant 3): site/src/cart.js imports web/, and the four route .meta.js files under site/src/routes (index, pricing, catalog, products/[slug]) import api/. Each is a move, not a defence; a ceiling that falls as they move.

allow.test-port-literal:web/test/verify-replic: 8333 is the port INSIDE the SeaweedFS container, mapped from the drive's own S3_PORT; nothing on the host binds it.
allow.test-port-literal:web/test/verify-tui.mj: 7999 is a port nothing holds, on purpose: the drive proves the frame renders with the API unreachable.
allow.test-port-literal:web/test/verify-widget: The buy-button HTML names the dev origins, and this drive rewrites each to the port it started (replaceAll on the three strings).
7710 is in the extension manifest's host permissions, a file the build emits, so the drive cannot pick its port at run time.
allow.test-port-literal:site/test/verify-accou: 8112 is the example API's own provider sink, bound from a literal there (FJS-2496); the drive follows it until that moves.
allow.css-raw-literal:widgets/src/Embeds/BuyBu: The widget renders in a shadow root on a stranger's page and restates the kit's color tokens under the package's own names, where a host's --ink cannot reach; none of them is a color that is the data (FJS-D1001).
allow.css-raw-literal:extension/src/dock/App.m: The popup page loads no @frontierjs/css and declares the kit's color tokens under its own names; none of them is a color that is the data (FJS-D1001).
allow.css-raw-literal:site/src/routes/index.me: The storefront's brand grounds (Dusk Navy, Mesa Orange) restated over theme-dark as tokens; a brand color is a theme's to name, which a themes layer in the stylesheet would own, so this is a move and not a defence (FJS-D1001).
allow.css-class-collision:widgets/src/Embeds/B: The widget renders in a shadow root on a stranger's page, where no @frontierjs/css reaches (see the style block), so .link is its own.
allow.css-class-collision:extension/src/dock/A: The popup page loads no @frontierjs/css (see the style block), so .bar and .empty are its own.
allow.css-class-collision:site/src/routes/_mod: The .topbar IS the kit's Topbar; the rule restyles the storefront's header on purpose.
allow.css-class-collision:site/src/islands/Acc: A button wearing the kit's Link on purpose; the rule resets the button chrome the Link does not mean to carry.
